mapper.insert: insert into report(reporter_id, target_type, target_id, reason, status, create_time) values (#{reporterId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{status}, now())
mapper.select: select r.*, case when r.target_type = 'USER' then u.username when r.target_type = 'GOODS' then g.name else null end as target_name from report r left join user u on r.target_type = 'USER' and r.target_id = u.id left join goods g on r.target_type = 'GOODS' and r.target_id = g.id order by r.status asc, r.create_time desc
